content: 'Ixaheritsixi kememɨte'ɨkɨ
Kepauka 'ixaheritsixi 'Ekipitu memayekɨ Muitsexi meta 'Aruni mewaruwitɨximekaku, mekaniuhukaitɨni yunaitɨ kuyaxi wahepaɨ.
Yawé Muitsexi ti'aitɨakaku katinaka'utɨwakaitɨni hakewa memeye'axekai hakewa memekɨkakai. Mɨpaɨ mekateniɨkɨne:

Mexɨakame metseritsie tamamata heimana 'auxɨwi 'umiekaku, xeitukari 'anukamiekaku Patsikwa 'ixɨarariyari me'uwewieka, mekanayekɨne 'ixaheritsixi Xamɨtsexi mɨrakutewatsie. Mete'ayu'iwaka 'ekipitutari wahɨxie mekanayekɨne,
mɨkɨ mexixi yuniwema matɨari miemete mewateukutɨwekai, Yawé mɨwarukwikai kwiniyakɨ. Yaxeikɨata yaputayɨkai kakaɨyarixi 'ekipitutari wahepaɨtsita.
'Ixaheritsixi Xamɨtsexi mekaniyekɨne, Tsukuti mekaniu'axɨani.
Manata memɨyekɨ Tsukuti, 'Etami mekaniu'axɨani, makumawe kwieyari manuye'atɨka.
Manata memɨyekɨ 'Etami, mekanakunuaxɨani Pi-'Akiruti, Wahari-Tsepuni tau manatineika hepatsie, Mikiruri hɨxie mekaniu'axɨani.
Manata memɨyekɨ Pi-'Akiruti mekananukɨne haramaratsie makumawetsie mekaniu'axɨani. Mana me'u'uwatɨ makumawetsie haika tukari 'Etami mɨrakutewatsie Maraha mekanitiyaxe.
Manata Maraha memɨyekɨ 'Erimi hepa mekanekɨne, mana kanitinenierekaitɨni tamamata heimana huta haixateyari meta haika tewiyari heimana tamamata takɨ 'amɨpapa mati'u, hikɨ mana mekanitiyaxe.
'Erimi memɨyekɨ Haramara Mɨxeta 'aurie mekaniu'axɨani.
Haramara Mɨxeta 'aurie memɨyekɨ Tsini makumawetsie mekaniu'axɨani.
Makumawetsie Tsini memɨyekɨ Ruka mekaniu'axɨani.
Ruka memɨyekɨ, 'Arutsi mekaniu'axɨani.
'Arutsi memɨyekɨ, Xepirini mekaniu'axɨani, hakewa 'ixaheritsixi haa memanuharenikɨ memɨkahexeiyakai.
Xepirini memɨyekɨ, Tsinahi makumawetsie mekaniu'axɨani.
Makumawetsie Tsinahi memɨyekɨ, Kiwuruti-Hatawa mekaniu'axɨani.
Kiwuruti-Hatawa memɨyekɨ, Katseruti mekaniu'axɨani.
Katseruti memɨyekɨ, Xima mekaniu'axɨani.
Xima memɨyekɨ, Ximuni-Peretsi mekaniu'axɨani.
Ximuni-Peretsi memɨyekɨ, Riwina mekaniu'axɨani.
Riwina memɨyekɨ, Xitsa mekaniu'axɨani.
Xitsa memɨyekɨ, Tserata rakutewakaku mekaniu'axɨani.
Tserata memɨyekɨ, Tsepexi hɨriyaritsie mekaniu'axɨani.
Tsepexi hɨriyaritsie memɨyekɨ, Karara rakutewakaku mekaniu'axɨani.
Karara memɨyekɨ, Makeruti rakutewakaku mekaniu'axɨani.
Makeruti memɨyekɨ, Takati rakutewakaku mekaniu'axɨani.
Takati memɨyekɨ, Teraki rakutewakaku mekaniu'axɨani.
Teraki memɨyekɨ, Mitika rakutewakaku mekaniu'axɨani.
Mitika memɨyekɨ, Katsimuna rakutewakaku mekaniu'axɨani.
Katsimuna memɨyekɨ, Mutseruti rakutewakaku mekaniu'axɨani.
Mutseruti memɨyekɨ, Wene-Yakani rakutewakaku mekaniu'axɨani.
Wene-Yakani memɨyekɨ, Kikahari hɨriyaritsie mekaniu'axɨani.
Kikahari hɨriyaritsie memɨyekɨ, Kutiwata rakutewakaku mekaniu'axɨani.
Kutiwata memɨyekɨ, 'Awuruna rakutewakaku mekaniu'axɨani.
'Awuruna memɨyekɨ, 'Etsihuni-Kewexi rakutewakaku mekaniu'axɨni.
'Etsihuni-Kewexi memɨyekɨ, Karetsi mekaniu'axɨani Tsini makumawetsie.
Karetsi memɨyekɨ, Huxi hɨriyaritsie mekaniu'axɨani 'Erumi kwieyari manuye'atɨka.
Yawé yahainekaku 'Aruni Huxi hɨriyaritsie nanutiyani, mana kaniumɨni mexɨakame tukaritsie 'auxɨwirieka metseritsie, huta tewiyari wiyari 'anuyemiekaku kepauka 'ixaheritsixi memayekɨ 'Ekipitu.
'Aruni kaniumɨni Huxi hɨriyaritsie xeitsienituyari heimana xeitewiyari heimana haika (123) wiyari hɨtɨ.
Ti'aitame kananeu tewiyari 'Arari mɨti'aitakai, Nekexi kiekame Kanani kwieyaritsie meta 'Ara, katinetimani kename 'ixaheritsixi 'ahurawa me'uhukai.
Huxi hɨriyaritsie memɨyekɨ, Tsarimuna rakutewakaku mekaniu'axɨani.
Tsarimuna memɨyekɨ, Pununi rakutewakaku mekaniu'axɨani.
Pununi memɨyekɨ, 'Uwuti rakutewakaku mekaniu'axɨani.
'Uwuti memɨyekɨ, 'Iye-'Awarini rakutewakaku mekaniu'axɨani, Muhawi kwieyari manuye'atɨka.
'Iye-'Awarini memɨyekɨ, Riwuni Kahari rakutewakaku mekaniu'axɨani.
Riwuni Kahari memɨyekɨ hikɨ 'Arimuni-Riwuratahini rakutewakaku mekaniu'axɨani.
'Arimuni-Riwuratahini memɨyekɨ hikɨ 'Awarini hɨriyaritsie mekanitiyaxe, Newu mɨrakutewa 'aurie.
'Awarini hɨriyaritsie memɨyekɨ, Muhawi makuweritsie mekaniu'axɨani, Kurutani 'aurie, Keriku hɨxie.
Kurutani 'utɨma mekanikuyaxe Weti-Yetsimuti meye'atɨkaitɨ 'Aweri-Tsitini me'unieretɨ, Muhawi kwieyari makuweritsie.
Kememɨte'utahɨawarie kwie memɨxatɨariekaitsie mieme
Muhawi makuweritsie, Kurutani 'aurie, metatsiere Keriku 'aurie, Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe:
«'Ixaheritsixi mɨpaɨ ketiniwarutahɨawi, kepauka Kurutanitsie memanɨkɨne kepauka Kanani memɨye'axɨani,
yunaime mana kiekatari mekaniwarayeweiyakuni yunaime wakakaɨyarixima memɨxixiyatɨka meta tepɨakɨ memɨwewiyatɨka mekaniwaka'unakuni. Metatsiere keniwaruta'aitɨa watukite memɨti'unakɨ,
xɨka xetehayu'iwa mana xepɨtiyaxe mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie nemɨxeyetuiri.

Mɨkɨ kwie pekaniwatawiyatsitɨamɨkɨ 'inɨarikɨ, 'iwamarixi hɨkɨa meke'ukuyaxixɨani. Kemɨ'ane nuiwari kwinimieme memɨyɨpaɨmeni mɨkɨ matsi kwie 'ayeukame mekani'axikuni, metatsiere kemɨ'ane yakɨ memɨyupaɨmeni mɨkɨ 'etsiyeume mekani'axikuni. Kemɨ'ane 'inɨarikɨ memi'axe mɨkɨ tiwapiini katinayeimɨkɨ, yunaitɨ nuiwari kememɨyupaɨmeni mɨpaɨ yeyeukame mekani'axikuni.
»Xɨkata xekawarayeweiya mana kiekatari hakewa xemetiyaxe, xɨka pɨta mana xewaruhayewa, mɨkɨ teɨteri 'uxa'awarie mekanixe'uximatɨakuni, xehɨxita mɨreuwiwieni hepaɨ yatɨni xuya xe'akita maweni hepaɨ.
Hikɨ ne 'anapɨta kexemɨwayurienikekai xemepɨta mɨpaɨ nekanixeyurimɨkɨ».
